title: Aligning to What? Limits to RLHF Based Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating overt biases by inserting explicit racial identifiers (e.g., 'Black', 'White', 'African-American') into text prompts, and prepending images of Black and White individuals in multimodal models, to measure the conditional probability of the model associating specific personality traits and occupations with those racial groups.

Measuring covert biases using matched-guise probing, which calculates the conditional probabilities of the model assigning specific personality traits and occupational prestige to dialogue samples written in African American English (AAE) versus Standard American English (SAE).
